programs.title: Deadly Patient
programs.desc: Dr. Hillary Spenser is known as 'The Angel of the East Wing'. However, a patient mistakes her compassion for adoration, fuelling his obsession to do whatever it takes to fulfil his misguided vision of their future together.

programs.title: Francesco
programs.desc: The life of St. Francis of Assisi from rich man's son to religious humanitarian.

programs.title: Lawless Range
programs.desc: Brothers, Sean and Tommy Donnelly live and work in modern day Texas. Tommy has always been troubled and Sean has always been there to help him but when Tommy gets himself $6,000 in debt to some very dangerous people there's not much Sean can do. And, at every turn, things just go from bad to worse.

programs.title: Clementine
programs.desc: Reeling from a one-sided breakup, heartbroken Karen breaks into her ex's lake house. There, she strikes up a complicated relationship with provocative younger woman Lana.

programs.title: Along Came the Devil
programs.desc: Growing up wasn't easy for Ashley, and in her quest for belonging, she accidentally welcomes an evil presence, leaving her family and friends in a desperate battle to save her.
